notes: discovery_rtt_ms is a local wall-clock measurement around one discovery call
latency is local_receive_us - exchange_timestamp_us and includes exchange/local clock offset
negative values are counted separately and excluded from percentiles
no latency value is reported when no timestamped events arrived
replica_connect_ms and replica_first_frame_ms are local wall-clock measurements of session setup and subscription-to-first-frame latency
replica skew compares the same symbol, exchange timestamp, clock and event shape across 2 connection(s); each delta is relative to the earliest arrival
the first 2 second(s) after all subscriptions are established are excluded so initial snapshots do not dominate the skew distribution
identical duplicate events at the same exchange timestamp and shape can be coalesced; unmatched events are counted as abandoned
a one-replica run reports no skew samples; skew requires at least two independent connections
